notes: Hand-authored, not derived. Paths are repo-relative to the corpus root; tests/** excluded. src/server/jobs/digest-email-job.ts (shouldRunForOrg) decides which organizations are due at this tick — org.settings.digestHourUtc against now.getUTCHours(), with archived orgs skipped. src/server/services/digest-service.ts (listDigestRecipients) decides who inside an organization is on the list. EXCLUDED: src/app/api/cron/digest/route.ts, the strongest distractor — its own header comment states it is a trigger and that runDigestEmailJob owns the due-organization decision. Also excluded: src/server/jobs/scheduler.ts and src/server/jobs/queue.ts (generic dispatch), src/emails/digest-email.tsx (rendering only), src/server/repositories/notification-preference-repository.ts (the query behind listDigestSubscribers, not the decision).
